# README banner and icon

`banner.jpg` is the picture at the top of the README. It was generated locally with Z-Image Turbo (bf16) in ComfyUI: 1536x640, 9 steps, cfg 1.0, sampler res_multistep, scheduler simple, seed 1101, then resized to 1280x533 and saved as JPEG. The same prompt and seed give the same picture.

Prompt:

> a friendly brass lantern-headed messenger robot reaching through a tall glowing library window to pull a single shining page from a vast archive of floating web pages beyond a locked iron gate, night, wide cinematic banner illustration, painterly digital art, soft volumetric light, rich but muted colour palette, detailed, storybook atmosphere, no text, no letters, no words, no logos, no watermark

`../../.claude-plugin/icon.png` is the plugin icon: the same model and settings at 1024x1024, seed 5505, cropped 80 px from each side (a faint mark sat in one corner), resized to 512x512.

Prompt:

> app icon, the round head of a friendly brass robot with big glowing blue eyes, holding a single glowing paper page in front of it, centered, simple bold shapes, painterly, deep night-blue background, soft warm glow, no text, no letters, no words, no logos
